name: efitware
description: Plan workouts, log training and understand your progress with your own AI.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, log and understand your training
defaultPrompt: Plan next week around my goals, equipment, recent workouts and calendar.
Help me record the results of my latest workout.
Review my training progress and suggest what to adjust.
interface.longDescription:
Build a training week around your goals, equipment, recent workouts and calendar. Create reusable routines and programs, record workout results, and explore your progress with the AI you choose. Ask for a draft first, then choose what to save. In clients that support MCP Apps, explore branded interactive workouts, templates, programs, goals and progress charts. Inspect a specific exercise or body measurement, enter results, mark sets done and review saved changes within your AI client.

Requires an eFitware account and a signed-in eFitware MCP connection; installing the plugin alone does not sign you in. In Codex, the eFitware MCP server is installed with the plugin: sign in when Codex prompts, or from the MCP servers section of its settings. In the Claude apps, open the plugin's Connectors tab and connect the eFitware server. No Node.js or local server is needed, and the built-in eFitware AI Coach can remain disabled. Setup: https://www.efitware.com/ai

Your AI client receives the training records it requests through this connection, including profile and health information available under your account permissions. Your AI provider handles its own use of that information under its policies. Manage permissions in your client and revoke access in eFitware Settings → Connected AI clients. Billing and irreversible account deletion are outside this connection.
